speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the characteristics of your rash, such as its color, texture, and exactly where it appears on your body. Also, when did these symptoms first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Scabies.

The combination of a pruritic rash lasting a year, specific involvement of the palms, and your occupation in farming and livestock care is highly suggestive of scabies. To confirm this, I need to see your skin under magnification; REQUEST IMAGES: Scabies_webbing_and_nodules.
